class_name: 逆接-仮定-ナイマデモ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Concedes a high standard on a verb's ない-form in order to insist on a lower one that must still be met (完璧に暗記しないまでも要点は押さえる). The second clause typically expresses a wish, request, or intention (〜たい, 〜てほしい, 〜べきだ) and often carries せめて or 少なくとも. Nouns and な-adjectives attach through ではない (専門家ではないまでも); the frame 〜とは言わないまでも is especially common, and ぬまでも is literary.

examples.ruby: 毎日[まいにち]とは言[い]わないまでも、週[しゅう]に一度[いちど]は連絡[れんらく]がほしい。
examples.english: I don't expect to hear from you every day, but I'd like a call at least once a week.

examples.ruby: 完璧[かんぺき]に暗記[あんき]しないまでも、せめて要点[ようてん]だけは押[お]さえるべきだ。
examples.english: Even if you don't memorize it perfectly, you should at least have the key points down.

examples.ruby: 優勝[ゆうしょう]は狙[ねら]えないまでも、決勝[けっしょう]までは進[すす]みたい。
examples.english: Winning it all may be out of reach, but we want to make it to the final at least.
